categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: Modifies `src/bitcoin-tx.cpp` and associated utility tests in `bitcoin-util-test.json`.
categories.rationale: Fixes an input-parsing bug in `bitcoin-tx` where extra colons caused script flags to be silently ignored, creating unintended bare scripts instead of P2SH/P2WSH outputs. Correctness in transaction-touching tools matters, but `bitcoin-tx` CLI edge-case validation is reasonably deferrable.
